synthesis.system_prompt_grounding: You are the authoritative Chief AI Career Coach at SkillBridge, calibrated on verified empirical data from over 18,000 tech postings and candidate trajectories across India. In every response, deliver prescriptive, data-grounded career advisory that cites precise salary bands in LPA alongside validated technical competencies. Rigorously evaluate user proficiencies against industry benchmarks spanning coding, statistics, and system architecture to identify actionable skill deficiencies. Always provide decisive, realistic career navigation tailored to tier-1 Indian technology hubs without resorting to generic advice.

ml-engineer.key_differentiator: Proven capability to optimize deep learning models for high-throughput, low-latency production deployment and edge execution.

data-scientist.key_differentiator: Translating ambiguous business metrics into rigorous hypothesis testing frameworks and production-ready predictive algorithms.

data-engineer.key_differentiator: Architecting resilient, distributed streaming and batch data pipelines with sub-minute SLA guarantees and automated data quality checks.

mlops-engineer.key_differentiator: Designing automated continuous training pipelines with comprehensive data drift detection, zero-downtime canary rollouts, and governance frameworks.

ai-researcher.key_differentiator: Authoring novel algorithmic architectures and fine-tuning frontier foundation models beyond standard API and off-the-shelf wrappers.

analytics-engineer.key_differentiator: Establishing software engineering best practices within the analytical layer via automated dbt testing, version control, and modular semantic layers.

hike_prediction_rules: Prioritize full-stack data proficiency: Juniors who pair advanced SQL and Python with productionized Big Data frameworks (Spark/Kafka) unlock 35% higher salary hikes compared to pure analytics profiles.
Bridge statistical depth with storytelling: High-increment candidates demonstrate clear correlation between core probability/A-B testing fundamentals and measurable executive business metrics.
Transition from exploratory notebooks to containerized code: Demonstrating modular, test-driven coding and Docker deployment commands upper-quartile entry-level compensation bands.
senior_leadership_rules: Cultivate high conscientiousness and operational resilience: Senior leaders achieve peak performance ratings by maintaining rigorous governance, systematic architectural reviews, and proactive risk mitigation.

Leverage low neuroticism for crisis stability: High-impact senior staff maintain emotional composure during production outages and organizational pivots, directly driving engineering velocity and team retention.

Channel openness to experience into strategic innovation: Elite engineering directors blend high intellectual curiosity with pragmatic technical trade-offs to modernize legacy pipelines without incurring uncontrolled tech debt.
synthesis.market_insights_summary: The 2026 Indian tech ecosystem shows rapid specialization, with tier-1 hubs—predominantly Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Delhi-NCR—commanding premium compensation for cross-functional engineering talent. Pure analytical roles are experiencing wage compression, while hybrid profiles combining distributed systems engineering with MLOps infrastructure observe record hiring multiples. Enterprise demand has decisively pivoted from exploratory data science toward scalable, resilient system deployments and cost-efficient foundation model fine-tuning.

jds_stats.key_finding: Candidates excelling in Coding and AI/ML combined with Storytelling consistently secure High salary hikes.

sds_stats.key_finding: High conscientiousness and openness to experience are the strongest predictors of senior engineering and data science success.
